questions.question: Discuss the ecological and economic importance of Holothuroidea.
questions.solution_html:
• Ecological importance- Holothurians are detritivores. They perform crucial ecosystem services by
  • recycling nutrients and maintaining seabed health. The physical mixing and burrowing of sediments by
  • sea cucumbers (bioturbation) improve the oxygenation and permeability of seafloor substrates.
  • Economic importance- Holothuroidea have been harvested for centuries and are used for producing
  • high-value seafood delicacyand medicinal products. (Liberal valuation).

questions.question: Explain the circulatory system in Prawn.
questions.solution_html:
• The prawn has an open circulatory system. The blood vascular system consists of heart, pericardium
  • arteries, blood lacunae, and haemolymph (haemocyanin). The heart pumps the blood into arteries
  • which branch out into the body cavity, allowing the blood to bathe the organs directly. From there, the
  • blood returns to the heart via a series of channels and sinuses after passing through the gills to pick up
  • oxygen. Blood carried to gills by afferent branchial channels. Pure blood after oxygenation is carried
  • to the pericardial sinus by efferent branchial channels. From there blood flows to heart through ostia.
questions.final_answer: to the pericardial sinus by efferent branchial channels. From there blood flows to heart through ostia
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Write a short essay on excretory system of Prawn.
questions.solution_html:
• The excretory system of a prawn is composed of a pair of antennary glands, also known as green
  • glands, which are located at the base of the antennae. Each gland has 4 parts: end sac, labyrinth
  • glandular tube, and bladder. A small excretory duct is continued from the bladder and it opens to the
  • exterior by an excretory pore on the coxal segment of antenna. (Explanation of all the parts- (5 marks))
questions.final_answer: exterior by an excretory pore on the coxal segment of antenna. (Explanation of all the parts- )
